title: Bacterial DNA extraction using modified Zymobiomics for short- and long-read sequencing
author: Thidathip Wongsurawat

steps.title: Lyse cells and bead‑beat
steps.instruction: Add lysis solution, add bacterial isolates, bead‑beat, then centrifuge to collect lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µl ZymoBIOMICS Lysis Solution to each ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube.
Using an inoculating loop, transfer a whole‑plate bacterial isolate into the tube and cap tightly.
Secure the tube in a bead beater or vortex with a 2 ml tube holder and run at maximum speed for 3 min (modified from the manufacturer’s 20 min).
Centrifuge the tubes at ≥10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and bind DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a filter, centrifuge, discard filter, add binding buffer and mix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 400 µl supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin III‑F Filter placed in a collection tube and centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 1 min; discard the filter.
Add 1,200 µl ZymoBIOMICS DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate and mix well.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Load mixture onto a Zymo‑Spin IIC‑Z Column, centrifuge, discard flow‑through, and repeat once.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 800 µl of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin IIC‑Z Column in a collection tube and centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min; discard the flow‑through.
Repeat the transfer of 800 µl and centrifugation as above.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add DNA Wash Buffer 1, centrifuge, and discard flow‑through.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the column in a new collection tube, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer 2
steps.instruction: Perform two washes with DNA Wash Buffer 2 (700 µl then 200 µl), centrifuging each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the column, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through.
Add 200 µl ZymoBIOMICS DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the column, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Elute DNA with nuclease‑free water and collect the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µl (minimum 50 µl) nuclease‑free water directly onto the matrix, incubate 1 min, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Pass eluate through HRC filter
steps.instruction: Prepare an HRC filter, add prep solution, centrifuge, then filter the eluated DNA.

substeps.instruction: Place a Zymo‑Spin III‑HRC Filter in a new collection tube and add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS HRC Prep Solution; centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 3 min.
Transfer the DNA eluate from the previous step to the prepared HRC filter in a clean 1.5 ml tube and centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 3 min. The DNA is now ready for optional cleanup.

steps.title: Magnetic bead DNA cleanup (optional)
steps.instruction: Perform magnetic‑bead purification of the extracted DNA following the steps below.

substeps.instruction: Allow magnetic bead reagent to reach room temperature.
Mix the bead reagent thoroughly until it appears homogeneous.
Add an equal volume of bead mixture to the DNA sample (e.g., 80 µl beads to 80 µl DNA).
Pipette up and down gently 10 times, then flick the tube 5 times; spin briefly (1–2 s).
Incubate at room temperature for 5–10 min.
Place the tube on a magnetic separation rack for 3 min to collect the beads.
Prepare fresh 80 % ethanol (400 µl ethanol + 100 µl nuclease‑free water).
While the tube remains on the magnet, aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant.
Add 200 µl 80 % ethanol, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then aspirate and discard; repeat for a total of two washes.
Remove the tube from the magnet, spin down for 1 s, place it back on the magnet, and use a 10 µl pipette to remove any residual ethanol.
Air‑dry the beads on the bench for 3–10 min until the surface is dry (not shiny).
Add 40 µl nuclease‑free water, flick 5 times until no clumps remain, spin 1–2 s, and incubate 2 min.
Place the tube on the magnetic rack and use a 10 µl pipette to transfer the purified DNA into a new tube.
Label and aliquot the purified DNA into two tubes (one for Illumina, one for Nanopore) and store at –20 °C unless proceeding directly to downstream applications.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure purity, concentration, and integrity of the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Purity: Pipette 1 µl DNA onto a NanoDrop; record OD260/280 (should be ~1.8) and OD260/230 (should be 2.0–2.2).
Concentration: Pipette 1 µl DNA onto a Qubit fluorometer and record the concentration.
Integrity: Load 1–5 µl DNA on a 0.8 % agarose gel alongside a 1 kb ladder (first lane) and a high‑molecular‑weight ladder (last lane); DNA showing bands above 10 kb indicates high integrity.
